knowledgeBase.title: How to request VPN access
knowledgeBase.body: Use the VPN request form when you need secure remote access. Include the business reason and manager approval. IT will enable the VPN profile and send connection instructions.
knowledgeBase.bodyHtml:
Request VPN access

Submit a VPN request with your business reason and manager approval. IT will enable the VPN profile and share connection instructions.

Before you request

  • Confirm you have a company device.
  • Confirm your manager approval is ready.

knowledgeBase.title: Fix Outlook profile sync
knowledgeBase.body: Restart Outlook, check your network connection, clear cached credentials, and recreate the Outlook profile if sync still fails.
knowledgeBase.bodyHtml:
Fix Outlook profile sync

  1. Restart Outlook.
  2. Check your network connection.
  3. Clear cached Microsoft 365 credentials.
  4. Recreate the Outlook profile if the mailbox still does not sync.

knowledgeBase.title: Printer troubleshooting checklist
knowledgeBase.body: Check power, paper, toner, network connection, and the print queue before opening a ticket.
knowledgeBase.bodyHtml:
Printer troubleshooting checklist

  • Confirm the printer has power.
  • Check paper and toner.
  • Confirm the printer is connected to the network.
  • Clear stuck jobs from the print queue.
